title: Kissed Glassy Polish Tamarind Mousse
description: A rich and festive Polish dessert featuring tamarind pulp, this mousse is a perfect treat for any occasion, with a glassy-jelly texture and a sweet and tangy flavor.
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 1/4 cup of water and let it sit for 5 minutes to soften.
In a medium saucepan, combine the tamarind pulp, sugar, and 1 cup of water, and heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool slightly, then stir in the softened gelatin, lemon juice, and vanilla extract until the gelatin is fully dissolved.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg whites until they become stiff and hold their shape.
In a large bowl, whisk together the egg whites and the tamarind mixture until well combined.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Place the cups or dish in a large pan of hot water to create a bain-marie, making sure the water level is below the top of the cups or dish.
Let the mousse cook in the bain-marie for 10-12 minutes, or until it is set and has a glassy-jelly texture.
Remove the cups or dish from the water bath and let them cool to room temperature.
Cover the cups or dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight until chilled and set.
